Stage3 struct names FIXED — MIRType field index swap (name/kind). Stage3 now has proper struct/enum names. 1 validation error remains (parameter naming in make_span). 15/15 golden, stage2 validates (1 PHI fix), stage3 nearly validates.

DefineVar approach tested — routes var defs through fn_blocks. Stage2 IR validates but stage2 BINARY still has the same vars loss. Root cause: the LowerState.vars list mutation loss is NOT specific to the vars field — it affects ANY state that goes through the lower_stmt→lower_let→define_var sret chain. The fn_blocks push works because it's done via GEP on the caller's alloca, not through a returned copy. Need to fundamentally change the state threading to use in-place mutation.

THREE-STAGE FIXED POINT REACHED! stage2.ll == stage3.ll (78,676 lines, 0 diff). Root cause of vars loss was WrapNone bug in lower_let: condition fired for Option-typed function call results, not just None literals. Fix: check is_none_literal flag before re-wrapping. The sret/COW hypothesis was a red herring — the actual bug was a 3-line logic error.
15/15 golden tests produce CORRECT OUTPUT when executed! While loop desugared to for+if. Fixed point preserved (78,840 lines, 0 diff).
